anlamlar.en: belonging to or connected with the speaker
belonging to or connected with the person or people you are speaking to
belonging to or connected with a man, boy or male animal
belonging to or connected with a woman, girl or female animal
belonging to or connected with a thing or animal
ornekler: The dog is eating its food.

anlamlar.en: belonging to or connected with the speaker and another person or other people
ornekler: Our house is near the sea.

anlamlar.en: belonging to or connected with two or more people or things
ornekler: The birds built their nest in the tree.

anlamlar.en: used instead of "his" or "her" when you do not know or do not want to say if a person is a man or a woman
ornekler: Everyone should bring their own lunch.

anlamlar.en: used before a noun to refer to a person or thing that is near you, or to the present time
used before a noun to refer to a person or thing that is not near you, or to a time in the past
ornekler: I was in Paris that summer.

anlamlar.en: used before a plural noun to refer to people or things that are near you
used before a plural noun to refer to people or things that are not near you
ornekler: Can you pass me those books?

anlamlar.en: used in questions and negatives to mean "some" or "even a small amount"
used to mean one of a group when it does not matter which
ornekler: You can call me at any time.

anlamlar.en: not any; not a
ornekler: There's no milk in the fridge.

anlamlar.en: used on signs to say that something is not allowed
every one of two or more people or things, considered separately
ornekler: There are flowers on each side of the road.

anlamlar.en: used to refer to all the members of a group, or to say how often something happens
ornekler: I go to the gym every day.

anlamlar.en: one or the other of two
both of two
ornekler: There are shops on either side of the street.
She had a bag in either hand.

anlamlar.en: not one and not the other of two
used to refer to two people or things together
the whole number or amount of something
ornekler: All the students passed the exam.

anlamlar.en: a large number of
ornekler: Many people live in this city.
How many brothers do you have?

anlamlar.en: a large amount of
ornekler: How much money do you need?

anlamlar.en: one more, or a different one
used to talk about something similar to what has been mentioned
ornekler: I've never seen such a beautiful place.

anlamlar.en: used to ask for information about people or things
used to show surprise or strong feeling
used to ask about one or more things from a limited group
ornekler: Which bus goes to the city center?

anlamlar.en: used to ask who something belongs to
to be able to
used to ask for or give permission
used to ask someone to do something
used to say that something is possible
ornekler: It can be very cold here in winter.

anlamlar.en: used as the past form of "can"
ornekler: I could read when I was four.
She couldn't come to the party.

anlamlar.en: used to ask politely for something or for permission
used to say that something is possible
used to make a suggestion
ornekler: We could go to the cinema.

anlamlar.en: used to say that something is possible
used to ask for or give permission (formal)
used to say that something is possible but not certain
ornekler: I might go to the party.
Take an umbrella – it might rain.

anlamlar.en: used to say that something is necessary or very important
ornekler: You must wear a seat belt.

anlamlar.en: used to say that something is very likely to be true
ornekler: You must be tired after your trip.
He must be at home – his car is outside.

anlamlar.en: used in the negative to say that something is not allowed
ornekler: Students must not use phones in class.

anlamlar.en: used with "I" and "we" to make suggestions or offers
ornekler: Shall we go for a walk?

anlamlar.en: used with "I" and "we" to talk about the future (formal)
ornekler: I shall never forget this day.

anlamlar.en: used to give advice or say what is the right thing to do
ornekler: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.

anlamlar.en: used to say that something is expected or likely
ornekler: The train should arrive at six.

anlamlar.en: used to talk about the future
ornekler: It will be sunny on Sunday.

anlamlar.en: used to make a decision at the moment of speaking, or a promise or offer
ornekler: I'll help you with your bags.

anlamlar.en: used to ask someone to do something
ornekler: Will you close the door, please?

anlamlar.en: used to talk about an imagined situation
ornekler: If I had money, I would buy a car.
It would be nice to see you.

anlamlar.tr: ister misiniz?, isterim (kibar teklif ve istek)
anlamlar.en: used in polite offers and requests
ornekler: I would like a glass of water.

anlamlar.en: used to ask someone politely to do something
ornekler: Would you open the door, please?

anlamlar.en: used as the past of "will", or to talk about things that happened often in the past
ornekler: When I was a child, we would play in the street.

anlamlar.en: used to say what is the right thing to do
